name: The IELTS 2026-27 Preparation Handbook — Indian Edition
tagline: The complete 30-page Indian-edition guide to IELTS — every 2026 fee and booking rule verified from IDP IELTS India, the band scale decoded with real averaging examples, skill-by-skill strategy for Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking, the One Skill Retake playbook, and the 8-week plan that takes you from diagnostic to test day.
